jobs.title: Senior Project Manager, Technology Group
jobs.description:
**About Phibro Animal Health Corporation**

**Phibro Animal Health Corporation** is a publicly traded, global organization with a rich history in animal health and nutrition as a manufacturer and marketer of medicated feed additives, vaccines, nutritional specialty products, and mineral nutrition. We strive to be a trusted partner with livestock producers, farmers, veterinarians, and consumers who raise or care for farm and companion animals by providing solutions to help them maintain and enhance the health of their animals.

  

Phibro is a diversified company in manufacturing and marketing products for ethanol performance, microbials for plants, home and industrial applications, and specialty chemicals for various industrial markets. In addition to, Phibro’s revenues are in excess of $1 billion and are supported by over 2,400 employees worldwide.

  

At Phibro, people are our greatest asset. We strive to develop a diverse workforce that fosters an environment where people feel supported in openly sharing their creativity and skills that allows them to be the most successful that they can be.

  

If you are interested in working for Phibro and feel that you do not meet all qualifications, we encourage you to apply as you might be the right candidate for this role or other positions.

  

The Senior Project Manager, Technology Group is an integral part of our Digital Information Delivery team based out of our US - Teaneck, NJ - Remote site.

**Position Details**
--------------------

Phibro is seeking an experienced and results-driven Senior Project Manager to lead the successful planning and delivery of complex, high-stakes, and highly visible strategic and operational IT projects across the enterprise. This remote role is ideal for a seasoned professional with a demonstrated record of leading large, cross-functional initiatives in changing or ambiguous environments, who thrives in cross-functional environments and is passionate about driving digital transformation. The Senior Project Manager will be responsible for stewarding projects through our process from concept to completion, and ensuring desired outcomes are aligned with Phibro’s broader technology and business goals. Our goal is to deliver projects on time, on budget, within scope, with quality, and with a high degree of stakeholder satisfaction—while protecting business continuity, managing risk, and realizing measurable benefits.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Lead key stakeholders through the project chartering process, ensuring that business outcomes are defined, projects are aligned with Phibro’s broader technology and business goals/strategies, and projects are designed to be successful at the start.
* Lead high-level and detailed planning and delivery of IT and data-related projects, including scope definition, resource planning, and schedule management across multiple business functions, geographies and workstreams.
* Provide concise, decision-ready updates to executive sponsors and steering committees.
* Lead internal resources and third parties/vendors to successfully deliver projects as one team, including negotiating priorities, resolving cross-functional conflicts, clarifying accountability, and holding partners to commitments.
* Develop detailed project plans, including timelines, milestones, and resource allocation to monitor and track progress.
* Manage changes to the project scope, schedule, and costs using appropriate verification techniques; evaluate business impact, present options and trade-offs, and drive timely decisions in a changing environment.
* Ensure approved quality testing practices are planned and followed, including acceptance criteria, operational readiness, cutover planning, and contingency plans that protect business continuity.
* Measure project performance using appropriate tools and techniques.
* Document and manage project risks and issues, implementing mitigation strategies and escalating as necessary.
* Successfully manage relationships with key stakeholders by building alignment among business, technology, data, security, compliance, finance, and vendor teams—even when priorities conflict.
* Drive process improvement to increase efficiency, quality, and outcomes.
* Partner with business and technology leaders to plan stakeholder engagement, communications, training, adoption, and reinforcement so that delivered solutions become sustained ways of working.
* Create and maintain comprehensive project documentation.
* Ensure the organization is set up for success after the project is complete (e.g., ROI, benefits realization) by defining benefit owners, baselines, targets, measurement timing, and handoff criteria before launch.
* Formally close projects, including documenting lessons learned and key close conversations.

**Key Competencies**
--------------------

Managing Time

Prioritizing and Organizing Work

Collaborative

Communicating Effectively

**Skills**
----------

Advanced organizational skills.

Prioritizes and plans work activities, uses time efficiently and develops realistic action plans.

Planning; ability to think ahead and plan, project activities and strategy over short-terms and extended time periods.

Ability to effectively present information to key managers and leadership team.

**Education & Experience**
--------------------------

* 8+ years of progressively responsible IT project or program delivery experience, or an equivalent combination of experience and demonstrated capability. Must include ownership of complex, high-stakes initiatives involving multiple business functions, senior stakeholders, significant dependencies, and changing requirements; experience in pharmaceutical, biotech, manufacturing, or another regulated environment is preferred.
* PMP, PRINCE2, or comparable project/program management certification.

jobs.title: Technical Project Manager
jobs.description:
**Job Overview**

We are seeking an energetic and detail-oriented Technical Project Manager to lead complex technology initiatives within enterprise software environments. In this role, you will drive project planning, execution, and delivery by leveraging your expertise in project management methodologies, cloud computing, and IT infrastructure. Your leadership will ensure seamless collaboration across cross-functional teams, adherence to best practices such as Agile and Waterfall, and successful implementation of enterprise solutions. This position offers an exciting opportunity to manage innovative projects that impact organizational growth and efficiency.

**Responsibilities**

* Lead end-to-end project management for enterprise software implementations, ensuring alignment with organizational goals and technical standards.
* Develop comprehensive project schedules using tools like Microsoft Project, Jira, or TFS, incorporating Agile planning techniques such as Scrum and Kanban.
* Coordinate requirements gathering sessions with stakeholders to define scope, deliverables, and success criteria; translate business needs into technical specifications.
* Manage project risks, issues, and dependencies proactively through risk management strategies and contingency planning.
* Oversee the creation of detailed test cases, user acceptance testing (UAT), and validation processes to ensure quality deliverables meet specifications.
* Facilitate effective communication among project stakeholders, including executive leadership, technical teams, vendors, and clients; provide regular status updates.
* Supervise project teams in software development lifecycle (SDLC) activities, including design, development, testing, deployment, and post-implementation support.

**Requirements**

* Proven experience managing complex IT projects within enterprise environments using methodologies such as Agile (Scrum/Kanban), Waterfall, or hybrid approaches aligned with PMBOK standards.
* Strong technical proficiency with cloud computing platforms like AWS; familiarity with IT infrastructure components including databases (SQL, Oracle), disaster recovery plans, and enterprise software solutions.
* Hands-on experience with project management tools such as Jira, VersionOne, Microsoft Project, TFS (Team Foundation Server), SharePoint, and Visio.
* Demonstrated leadership in technical project & program management supervision; excellent team-building skills across cross-functional groups.
* Deep understanding of SDLC processes including requirements gathering, software implementation, release management, and user acceptance testing.
* Excellent organizational skills with the ability to prioritize tasks effectively while managing multiple projects simultaneously.
* Strong communication skills to facilitate stakeholder engagement and negotiate project scope or resources when necessary.
* Knowledge of IT governance frameworks and compliance standards related to enterprise solutions implementation.

Join us to lead transformative technology projects that shape the future of enterprise solutions! Your expertise will drive innovation while fostering collaboration across diverse teams—making a tangible impact every day!

Pay: $210,000.00 - $300,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching
* Flexible schedule
* Life insurance
* Paid time off

Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: NC3 Program Analyst
jobs.description:
Overview:

Systems Planning and Analysis, Inc. (SPA) delivers high-impact, technical solutions to complex national security issues. With over 50 years of business expertise and consistent growth, we are known for continuous innovation for our government customers, in both the US and abroad. Our exceptionally talented team is highly collaborative in spirit and practice, producing results that matter. Come work with the best! We offer opportunity, unique challenges, and clear-sighted commitment to the mission. SPA: Objective. Responsive. Trusted.

The Joint, Office of the Secretary of War, Interagency Division provides expert support services to a range of customers spanning across the Department of War, Federal Civilian, and international markets. JOID provides a diverse portfolio of analytical and programmatic capabilities to help our customers make informed decisions on their most challenging issues.

The Acquisition and Technology Analysis Group within JOID specializes in the application of multi-disciplinary analytic skills to support multiple clients within the Department of War (DoW). These clients include the Office of the Under Secretary of War for Research and Engineering (OUSW(R&E)), Office of the Under Secretary of War for Acquisition and Sustainment (OUSW(A&S)), DARPA, the Joint Staff, and USINDOPACOM. SPA provides critical decision support to enabling and executing a strategy of technological superiority and enabling the delivery and sustainment of secure, resilient, and preeminent capabilities to the warfighter quickly and cost effectively. Our team of experienced military, technical, and operations research analysts is skilled in evaluating military problems, identifying the driving factors, devising innovative approaches, collecting applicable data, developing necessary software tools, and performing thorough and timely assessments to inform technology and acquisition governance decisions to ensure U.S. military forces retain military superiority in the future.

We have an immediate need for an NC3 Program Analyst to provide onsite support at the Pentagon in Arlington, VA.

Responsibilities:

The NC3 Program Analyst will support the Nuclear Command, Control, and Communications team within the Office of the Assistant Secretary of Defense for Nuclear Deterrence, Chemical, and Biological Defense Policy and Programs. The analyst will provide technical leadership and analysis to evaluate and integrate NC3 indications and warning and situation monitoring capabilities, applying knowledge of current Integrated Tactical Warning and Attack Assessment systems, their capabilities, and their limitations. The role will coordinate with program sponsors, Department of War NC3 program leadership, and other key stakeholders while supporting the integration of investment portfolios, critical development paths, and mission analysis across the NC3 enterprise. The analyst will assess capabilities against traditional and emerging threats, monitor nuclear threat monitoring research and engineering investments, and promote the timely delivery of high quality technical products using sound engineering practices. The analyst will also prepare senior leaders for engagements by developing briefing books, read ahead memoranda, decision materials, and other executive products that clearly synthesize complex technical and programmatic information.

Qualifications:

**Required:**

* Master's degree
* 10+ years experience with defense acquisition, capability development, portfolio management, systems engineering, or replaced mission analysis
* Knowledge of defense acquisition and resource allocation processes
* Demonstrated ability to synthesize complex technical and programmatic information into clear papers, briefings, presentations, and decision materials for senior defense leaders
* Strong analytical, organizational, writing, and presentation skills
* Active TS/SCI clearance
* Able to work fully onsite at the Pentagon

**Desired:**

* Experience in one or more of the following areas: indications and warning, NC3 Integrated Tactical Warning and Attack Assessment, ballistic missile defense, defense space systems, or ground based sensor systems
* Experience conducting technical or programmatic analysis of NC3 systems, programs, architectures, or capabilities
* Knowledge of the NC3 mission, concepts of operations, organizations, and stakeholder relationships across the Department
* Experience supporting OSW, the Joint Staff, a military service headquarters, or a comparable organization
* Project Management Professional certification, DAWIA Program Management certification, or a comparable acquisition credential

Pay Range Information: At SPA, we strive to deliver a robust total compensation package that will attract and retain top talent. Elements of the compensation package include competitive base pay and variable compensation opportunities. SPA provides eligible employees with an opportunity to enroll in a variety of benefit programs, generally including health insurance, flexible spending accounts, health savings accounts, retirement savings plans, life and disability insurance programs, and a number of programs that provide for both paid and unpaid time away from work. The specific programs and options available to any given employee may vary depending on eligibility factors such as geographic location, date of hire, etc. Please note that the salary information shown below is a general guideline only. new_jobs.title: Senior Security Analyst
new_jobs.description:
Job Description
  
  
Personnel shall provide ASU project specific analytical support in the performance of ASU’s acquisition security mission. Personnel shall assist ASU in the vetting process for acquisitions. Personnel shall be expected to support meetings, draft and review documents, correspond with Government personnel and other vendors, and provide other related services in performance of this contract, specifically in the areas of an Industrial Security Professional or Management and Program Analyst, to include:
  
Plan, perform, facilitate, and assist with analyzing known and potential risks and threats directed at the Intelligence Community (IC), including but not limited to the FBI.
  
Conduct background research utilizing all available sources.
  
Attain or develop Company Key Management Personnel Listings (KMPL) as required.
  
Review and utilize IC Threat Matrix.
  
Assign Company Threat Scores.
  
Write Threat Assessments and related documents.
  
Utilize Resource Checklists.
  
Support the National Industrial Security Program (NISP) and all related components.
  
,
  
Required Skills
  
  
Bachelor’s degree or demonstrate five (5) years professional experience utilizing analytical skills and writing ability to present viable alternatives and make professional recommendations.
  
Eight (8) years demonstrated knowledge and application of NISPOM standards.
  
Five (5) years demonstrated knowledge and application of Executive Orders (EOs), Security Executive Agent Directives (SEADs), and Federal Investigative Standards (FISs) related to obtaining and maintaining a personnel security clearance.
  
Demonstrated experience in industrial security matters, pertinent national industrial security policies, directives, and programs.
  
Demonstrated skill in industrial security, acquisitions protective processes, life-cycle procurement, technology review and studies, counterintelligence and security methodologies, standards, and techniques.
  
Ability to represent an organization at various level committees, subcommittees, working groups or forums, which is directly related to industrial security issues and matters.
  
Ability to write comprehensive and concise reports, and present and brief executive level management, internal and external to an organization.
  
Knowledge of the various security disciplines (i.e., physical, technical, information, industrial, operation, security force, and procedural security).
  
Knowledge and experience in the use of Open Source research.
  
Must be willing and able to undergo a CI polygraph.
  
,
  
Desired Skills
  
  
FBI Experience
  
Experience as a Facility Security Officer
  
Experience in Intelligence Analysis
  
,
  
About A2 Federal
  
  
A2 Federal is dedicated to augmenting the United States' national security efforts, domestically and abroad. We specialize in intelligence, language, and information technology/cyber services to support the Department of Defense, the Intelligence Community, and other agencies across the federal government.
